Name: Galactic User Interface
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][u][b][size=4]Description[/size][/b][/u]
[size=3]Like I said, I'm not a modder or a coder - I'm just kind of bumbling my way through this, so if you find any mistakes or missing pixels PLEASE let me know. It might be a little bit until I can figure out exactly what the problem is but there will be updates for sure.[/size]
[/center]
[center][color=#ffff00][u][b][size=6]How to Install[/size][/b][/u][/color][/center]
[center][size=3]Drag and drop the [CP] Galactic UI from the .rar into your mods folder. That's it!
[b]I'd recommend downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings[/url] if you have difficulty reading the fonts.[/b][/size]

[b][u][color=#ffff00][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/color]
[/u][/b][size=3][b][i]With the 3.0 rework of Galactic, compatibility has been wiped. I'm planning the following:[/i]

[b]- Generic Mod Config Menu[/b]
[b]- Font Settings[/b]
[b]- Mod Update Menu[/b][/color][b][color=#00ff00]
- Binning Skill
- Sword & Sorcery
- Fashion Sense
- Event Lookup[/color]
